title: Stylish, peaceful guesthouse in Lockeland Springs
description:
Our relaxing, clean, fully equipped Lockeland Springs guesthouse is a perfect getaway. It’s tastefully decorated, tidy, uncomplicated, and comfortable. 

You'll be walkable to top rated coffee shops, bars, restaurants, and Jeni’s ice cream. Shelby Park is nearby, and grocery stores are a 3 min drive. We have dedicated 1 gig fiber internet.

We follow the Airbnb 5 Step Enhanced Cleaning protocol and are a 100% smoke free property. We love making our guests' stays memorable ones!

The space
Our backhouse is detached from our home. You enter from the alley where you have a dedicated parking spot. 

The interior is simple and relaxing, with an industrial chic vibe. We have concrete floors, dimmable lighting, keyless entry, a fully equipped kitchen and laundry, and fiber internet.

Guest access
You have access to the private patio attached to the backhouse along with a dedicated parking pad adjacent to the alley.

Other things to note
We are a completely non-smoking property. Any hint of smoking will forfeit the reservation. 

We do not allow pets. 

Our couch does not pull out into a sofa bed. :)

We do not allow parties, loud music, or additional guests to stay the night outside of what is on your reservation.
